test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the organization of village panchayat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 40**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 40** of the Constitution of India deals with the **organization of village panchayats**.
 
• It falls under **Part IV** of the Constitution, which contains the **Directive Principles of State Policy**.
 
• This article directs the state to organize village panchayats and endow them with powers and authority to function as units of self-government.
 
• The aim is to promote decentralization and empower local self-governance in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Directive Principles of State Policy are guidelines to the central and state governments of India to be kept in mind while framing laws and policies.
 
• They are** not justiciable in a court of law** but are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• The aim of these principles is to create social and economic conditions under which citizens can lead a good life.
 
• They emphasize that the state should strive to promote the welfare of the people by securing and protecting a social order in which justice—social, economic, and political—shall inform all institutions of national life.
 
• The **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992**, further strengthened the role of **Panchayati Raj Institutions **(PRIs) by giving them constitutional status.
